first_words: He fired at the car as it rounded the corner
aiming at the Archduke and Duchess
But he wasn't the first one to try
Two assassins had already lost their nerve
A third threw a bomb, but it bounced off
and blew up under the car behind
Then the driver took one wrong turn
right onto the street where another assassin was waiting
Two shots and the Archduke and his wife were dead
Their country declared war, the Allies piled in
and that one wrong turn started World War I
